$schema.description: The decide-verdicts format's shape, named by the phax release that last changed it (not necessarily the release that wrote this file): https://docs.phax.run/schemas/decide-verdicts/<X.Y.Z>.json

artifact.description: The repo-relative path of the artifact the verdicts are for. phax compares it with the artifact argument and never reads the artifact from it.
artifact.title: nonEmptyString

question.description: The id of a question of the artifact.

chosen.description: The id of the option chosen: one of the question's option ids, or the reserved `other`.

note.description: The person's note: why this option, or what `other` means. null when there is none. phax refuses a null note on a verdict that departs from the question's recommendation, `other` included, a check this schema does not express.

verdicts.description: The verdicts, at most one per question.
